item.title: How It Works
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
How a Brew-n-Chill kiosk works

A complete, self-running coffee bar — installed in an afternoon and managed for you.

1. We survey your space

We look at footfall, power (a standard outlet is usually enough), water options (plumbed or bottled), and the spot that will catch the most traffic. Location is the single biggest driver of performance, so we get it right before anything ships.

2. We recommend the right machine

Small office? A compact 30-cup-per-hour unit. Airport or busy campus? A high-throughput robotic kiosk that pushes 60+ drinks an hour. We match the machine to your volume, drink menu and budget — purchase, lease or revenue-share.

3. We install and brand it

Delivery, setup and a working first cup typically happen in a single visit. The kiosk is wrapped in Brew-n-Chill branding (or co-branded with you) and loaded with our beans, milk options and syrups, all dialled in for the machine.

4. Guests order and pay themselves

Touchscreen or phone, tap or scan to pay, drink in under a minute. Customers choose espresso, latte, cappuccino, flat white, americano, hot chocolate, iced and cold-brew options — barista-grade, every time, with no human in the loop.

5. We keep it running

Remote monitoring flags low stock and service needs before anyone notices. Restocking takes about an hour a day (we can do it or train your team), and ingredients run around 20–25% of revenue. Telemetry, sales and uptime are visible to you in a simple dashboard.

What you don't have to deal with

  • No hiring, training, scheduling or covering shifts.
  • No barista skill required — the machine is the barista.
  • No build-out: it's an appliance, not a café fit-out.
  • No surprise downtime: connected machines alert us first.

item.title: The Machines
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The machines

We're technology-agnostic. We curate the best automated coffee hardware on the market and stand behind every unit we install — so you get the right machine, not whatever one brand happens to sell.

Compact Kiosk

A countertop or slimline automated barista for smaller offices, studios and waiting rooms. Up to ~30 drinks per hour, fits almost anywhere with a power outlet, and serves the espresso-based core menu plus hot chocolate.

  • Best for: 10–80 daily cups
  • Footprint: countertop / ~1 m²
  • Hot drinks, optional iced

Pro Kiosk

Our workhorse free-standing unit for busy offices, gyms, hotels and clinics. Bean-to-cup espresso, fresh-milk options, syrups, and iced/cold-brew. Self-cleaning cycles and a large hopper mean fewer touches per day.

  • Best for: 60–150 daily cups
  • Footprint: ~1.5–2 m²
  • Full menu, fresh milk, iced & cold brew

Robotic Barista Kiosk

A fully robotic, glass-fronted coffee bar for airports, malls, campuses and flagship lobbies. A theatrical robotic arm, 60+ drinks per hour, app pre-ordering and a complete specialty menu. It's an attraction as much as an amenity.

  • Best for: 100–400+ daily cups
  • Footprint: ~2–4 m²
  • Robotic service, app ordering, premium menu

Every machine includes

  • Cashless payment (tap, chip and mobile wallet) and optional QR / app ordering.
  • Remote telemetry: sales, stock levels, uptime and fault alerts.
  • Self-cleaning and automated maintenance cycles.
  • Brew-n-Chill branding — or co-branding with your organisation.
  • Brew-n-Chill beans, milk and syrups tuned to the machine.

Not sure which fits? That's our job. Tell us your space and footfall and we'll spec it.

item.title: Industries We Serve
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Industries we serve

Captive audiences and long hours are where automated coffee shines. These are the spaces we know best.

Offices & coworking

The flagship use case. Quality coffee ranks among the top three workplace perks for retention, and with replacement costs at 50–200% of salary, a kiosk that keeps one good hire is already paid for. No more cheap drip pot — a real café in the breakroom, with no office manager playing barista.

Gyms & fitness studios

Pre-workout espresso, post-workout protein lattes and cold brew — an extra revenue line and a membership perk that runs itself while your team focuses on the floor.

Hotels & serviced apartments

24/7 lobby coffee the front desk never has to make. Guests get specialty drinks at any hour; you get an amenity with no labour and a new ancillary revenue stream.

Hospitals & healthcare

Staff on night shifts and visitors in waiting rooms need coffee when the café is shut. Unattended kiosks deliver consistent quality around the clock in a tiny footprint.

Universities & campuses

High footfall, long hours and a captive student audience. Moving a machine from a moderate-traffic office (~55 cups/day) to a busy campus (~95+ cups/day) can lift monthly net profit by 40–60%.

Retail, transit & convenience

Malls, stations, forecourts and lobbies. A full coffee offer in two square metres turns dead corners into 24/7 micro-retail.

Don't see your space? If people walk past it and want coffee, we can probably make the numbers work.

item.title: Pricing & ROI
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pricing & ROI

Three ways to get a kiosk, and honest numbers behind all of them.

Three ways to work with us

Buy

Own the machine outright. Best lifetime value if you have the capital and a strong location. We handle install, branding, supply and service.

  • You own the asset
  • Lowest cost per cup over time
  • Optional service plan

Lease

Spread the cost monthly with little money down. Maintenance and software included. Upgrade as the range improves.

  • Low upfront cost
  • Maintenance included
  • Predictable monthly fee

Revenue share

For the right high-traffic sites, we place the machine at little or no cost and split the takings. We're only paid when it performs.

  • Little/no upfront cost
  • Aligned incentives
  • We carry the hardware risk

What the machines cost

Automated coffee hardware spans a wide range depending on throughput and features:

  • Entry / compact: roughly $2,000–$7,500
  • Mid-range professional: roughly $10,000–$25,000
  • Premium robotic kiosk: roughly $28,000–$60,000+

Indicative market ranges — your exact quote depends on the model, contract type and supply agreement. Ask us for a tailored number.

A worked example (single office machine)

  • 60 cups/day × $4 average price = $240/day revenue
  • Ingredients ~$0.80/cup (20–25% of revenue)
  • ≈ $5,760/month gross profit before location costs
  • ≈ $3,000–$4,000/month net per machine after location fee, power and restocking
  • Typical payback: 12–18 months (as fast as 6–12 in prime spots)

Location is everything. The same machine that does 55 cups/day in a quiet office can do 95+ on a busy campus — a 40–60% swing in monthly profit. We help you place it right.

Want your own numbers?

Send us your location type, opening hours and rough footfall and we'll model revenue, costs and payback for your specific site — no obligation.

item.title: Our Coffee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Our coffee

The machine is only half the story. Brew-n-Chill is a coffee brand first — we choose the beans, build the blends and tune every recipe so the kiosk pours like a café.

Beans worth the machine

Great hardware pouring mediocre coffee is just a faster way to make a bad cup. We source specialty-grade beans, roast for consistency, and profile each blend specifically for automated extraction — grind, dose, temperature and pressure all dialled to the machine, not a barista's guesswork.

The Brew-n-Chill range

Signature Blend

Balanced, chocolatey and crowd-pleasing — the everyday house espresso behind every latte and flat white.

Bold Roast

Darker, punchier and unapologetic, for people who take their morning seriously.

Chill Cold Brew

Smooth, low-acid and built for iced and cold-brew menus — the 'chill' half of the name.

'Brew' and 'Chill' — hot and iced, done well

The name is the menu. Brew covers the full hot line — espresso, latte, cappuccino, flat white, americano, hot chocolate. Chill covers iced lattes, cold brew and refreshers. One kiosk, both moods, all day.

Consistency is the feature

A café is only as good as its worst barista on their worst day. Our beans plus automated precision mean the 400th cup tastes like the first. That reliability is what turns a novelty into a habit — and a habit into recurring revenue.

Curious how it tastes? Book a tasting and we'll bring the coffee to you.

About Brew-n-Chill

We make great coffee effortless for the places people work, train, heal, study and pass through.

Everyone wants good coffee on site. Almost nobody wants to hire baristas, manage a café, or babysit a temperamental machine. Brew-n-Chill closes that gap: we bring the technology, the beans and the service, and you get a self-running coffee bar that just works.

Technology partner and coffee brand

Most companies in this space sell you a box. We do two jobs at once. As a technology reseller we pick the best automated kiosks on the market, install them and keep them running. As a coffee brand we make sure what comes out of them is genuinely worth drinking. Hardware that performs, coffee that delivers — under one roof.

How we work

Whether you run an office, a gym, a hotel or a hospital, we'd love to show you what good automated coffee looks like.

item.title: FAQ
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Frequently asked questions

How much space does a kiosk need?

Most units fit in about 1–2 square metres — roughly a vending-machine footprint. Compact models sit on a countertop; robotic kiosks need up to ~4 m².

What does it need to run?

A standard power outlet and either a plumbed water line or a refillable tank. We confirm everything in the site survey.

Who maintains and restocks it?

We do, or we train your team. Connected machines alert us to low stock and service needs automatically; day-to-day restocking is about an hour.

How do customers pay?

Tap, chip, mobile wallet, and optional QR / app ordering. You can also set drinks to free (employer-subsidised) or any price you like.

Is the coffee actually good?

Yes — that's the whole point. We use specialty-grade Brew-n-Chill beans tuned for the machine, so the quality is café-level and identical cup after cup.

Buy, lease or revenue-share?

All three. Buying is cheapest long-term, leasing keeps upfront cost low, and revenue-share suits high-traffic sites where we place the machine and split takings. See Pricing & ROI.

How fast can we go live?

Once the machine and location are confirmed, install and first cup usually happen in a single visit. Book a demo and we'll map out the timeline.

Still have questions? Ask us
